claims.claim: Infleqtion reported on September 24 that Sqale achieved 30 entangled logical qubits using 80 physical qubits, meeting its stated 2026 roadmap milestone; this reduces uncertainty around milestone execution but does not by itself establish commercial quantum advantage or customer economics.

The same issuer disclosure explicitly keeps commercial readiness, the 100-logical-qubit 2028 target, 1,000-logical-qubit 2030 target, commercialization, contract realization and quantum advantage subject to forward-looking execution risk, so Alpha should separate demonstrated technical milestone from future economic conversion.

risks.risk: A demonstrated logical-qubit milestone does not establish commercial readiness, durable customer economics, or quantum advantage over classical substitutes.
Future 2028/2030 scaling targets and contract/commercialization outcomes remain execution-dependent.

contradictions.contradiction: The prior Beta unknown that independent verification of the targeted 30 logical qubits remained open is partly stale because the company has now reported achieving the milestone; independent third-party verification and customer economics remain open.
contradictions.disposition: technical milestone status updated; preserve economic-validation uncertainty

unknowns.unknown: Independent third-party verification of the 30-logical-qubit result and customer workload economics remain open.

assistOutcome.strategyChange: Used a newer primary technical-milestone disclosure rather than repeating prior Q2 financial-risk lineage; narrowed the remaining falsifier from milestone achievement to independent validation and economic conversion.
